title: Exploring the Potential of a Deep Learning Model for Early CT Detection of High-Grade Metastatic Epidural Spinal Cord Compression and Its Impact on Treatment Delays.
summary: Previously developed deep-learning model evaluated on staging CT from 95 of 140 MESCC patients against MRI-informed radiologist and surgeon review; DLM agreement kappa .891 and retrospective potential delay reduction 20±28 days. Single-center retrospective analysis; delay reduction modeled, not prospectively demonstrated. The reviewed source supports this bounded result; external generalization, causal effects, and sustained operational impact remain unestablished where the source reports retrospective or internal evaluation.
